evals.prompt: I just got this contract from Acme Corp, it's at /data/incoming/acme-msa-2026.pdf. Can you process it so I can search it later? I'm doing a review of all our vendor agreements.
evals.expected_output: Agent should call convert_document with the PDF path, choose a meaningful collection name (not 'default'), include caller metadata, and report back which collection it used and how many chunks were created.

assertions.text: Uses convert_document (not ingest) for a single file
Collection name is descriptive and project-relevant (not 'default')
Includes agent_type in caller metadata
Includes initiated_by with user:denson format
Includes agent_notes describing the vendor review context
Calls list_collections first to check existing collections
Applies relevant tags to the document
User-facing message mentions collection name and chunk count

evals.prompt: I uploaded a bunch of research papers to /data/incoming/q4-research/ — there's like 12 PDFs and a few DOCX files in there. Can you get them all into the system? I'll want to search across them later for stuff about pricing models.
evals.expected_output: Agent should use the ingest tool (not convert_document one by one), choose a descriptive collection, include caller metadata, and tell the user how many files were found.

assertions.text: Uses ingest tool (not convert_document) for a directory of files
Collection name is descriptive (e.g. 'q4-research')
Sets file_types filter to ['pdf', 'docx']
Includes agent_notes mentioning pricing models research context
Includes initiated_by with user:denson format
User-facing message sets expectations about processing time
Does NOT fabricate async job_id or queue-based workflow
Applies tags relevant to the research topic

evals.prompt: What did that Acme contract say about termination? I think there was something about a 90-day notice period but I'm not sure.
evals.expected_output: Agent should search first (not guess), use search tool with a relevant query, scope to collection if possible, include caller metadata, and synthesize an answer from results.

assertions.text: Calls search tool BEFORE attempting to answer the question
Search query includes termination-related terms
Includes caller metadata (agent_type, initiated_by, agent_notes)
Attempts to scope search to a relevant collection (not all collections)
Plans to synthesize answer from results (not dump raw chunks)
Includes fallback plan if document not found
Does NOT guess or fabricate contract terms from memory
